backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the farm bookkeeping backend with user profile storage, auto-registered admin bootstrapping (up to 4 admins), and a user approval system with role-based access control for all endpoints.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the flat navigation button row in Dashboard.tsx was replaced with a single shadcn DropdownMenu trigger listing all sections.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing each component's purpose and recent changes such as dropdown navigation, approval flow, and 'Entered By' columns.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Pepper Farm Bookkeeping React app, mounting the app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that orchestrates authentication, bootstrap registration, profile setup, and approval-state routing to render LoginPrompt, a loading spinner, WaitingForApprovalScreen, or Dashboard based on user state.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying the current year copyright and a caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM parameters derived from the app's hostname.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Application header showing the Pepper Farm branding, the authenticated user's name, and a login/logout button that clears React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LoginPrompt.tsx: Landing page for unauthenticated users featuring a hero image and four feature cards (Income/Expense, Inventory, Customers, Dashboard) with a prompt to log in.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name before accessing the app, submitting via the useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/RejectedScreen.t: Displays an 'Access Not Approved' screen for users whose account requests were rejected, with a sign-out button that clears identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/tabs/AttendanceT: Renders a workers list with an add-worker dialog and an info banner directing users to the Farm Time tab for daily attendance tracking.
frontend/src/components/tabs/CustomersTa: Displays a searchable customer list with add-customer functionality and a per-customer purchase history dialog showing sales records.
Manages farm expense records with add, edit, and delete operations, category filtering, search, and a running total displayed in Naira.
frontend/src/components/tabs/FarmTimeTab: Provides a monthly calendar view for recording worker daily attendance, including arrival/departure times and present/absent status per worker.
frontend/src/components/tabs/IncomeTab.t: React component for displaying and adding farm income records, with search/filter controls, a data table, and a dialog form for submitting new income entries.
frontend/src/components/tabs/InventoryTa: React component for managing farm inventory items, supporting add and edit operations via a dialog form, with search/filter and a table displaying stock and value.
frontend/src/components/tabs/SalesTab.ts: React component for recording and viewing farm sales transactions, linking customers and inventory items, with a searchable table and a dialog form for new sales.
React component that aggregates income, expenses, inventory value, and recent transactions into summary cards with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/tabs/Verificatio: React component for managing user access approvals, allowing admins to approve or reject pending principal requests via confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/WaitingForApprov: Shows a pending-approval screen where users can send an approval request and manually refresh their approval status.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state and persisting identity via AuthClient. Exposes login status flags, identity object, and login/clear functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including user profiles, approvals, inventory, sales, income, expenses, customers, workers, and attendance. Also includes a bootstrap hook to trigger auto-admin registration on app load.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including sidebar, chart, and UI element variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page component that renders a dropdown navigation menu and conditionally displays tab content for summary, income, expenses, inventory, customers, sales, attendance, farm time, and an admin-only verification tab.
frontend/src/utils/farmTime.ts: Date and time utility functions for the Farm Time calendar feature, including month grid generation, nanosecond conversion helpers, time parsing/formatting, and duration formatting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for sensitive parameters like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based colors, border radii, accordion animations, and enabling the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the Pepper Farm Bookkeeping project, including existing features (navigation dropdown replacing flat nav buttons) and a pending feature request to consolidate navigation into a dropdown menu.
